title: phebalium glandulosum subsp. eglandulosum
intro: Phebalium glandulosum subsp. eglandulosum, commonly known as the Tasmanian silver-pea, is a species of plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant is native to Tasmania, Australia, and has been used traditionally in medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Phebalium glandulosum subsp. eglandulosum include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of analgesia, anti-diarrheal, and expectorant properties.
